articles.author: Zack Whittaker
articles.title: Samsung bans smart TV apps that share users’ internet connections with strangers - techcrunch.com
articles.description: New security research offers a rare view inside residential proxy networks, which rely on apps that share a person's internet connection with someone else.
articles.content: Several popular Samsung smart TV apps contain code that share the owner’s internet connection with strangers, potentially putting millions of Samsung smart TVs at risk of hijacking, according to new … [+5444 chars]
